referenceDevice: BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988A/Filogic 880) — tri-band Wi-Fi 7 EasyMesh extender
measurementCondition: Valid 60-second aggregate /proc/stat sample (idle-delta method); all 4 cores online at 1800 MHz, governor=performance; idle/light-load shortly after boot, no active client traffic. Not a controlled multi-client or steering-load test.
notes: Only aggregate CPU utilization has been measured (2.47% averaged over a valid 60-second window, load average 0.35/0.47/0.26); no per-process CPU time or percentage breakdown has been captured. This is an idle/light-load result and does not demonstrate sustained forwarding, steering, or multi-client performance. Per-process CPU profiling and loaded-workload testing remain open items.
